validation: Clean x64 Release build with MSVC on GitHub Actions; unit tests pass.

The fix in 1.0.1 was tested in game with a test plugin hooking the class getter: 1.0.0 turned the panel and swaps off, the fix kept them on and swapped specs both ways in town. A player whose plugins caused the bug confirmed the fix. That build reported version 1.0.0; only the version number changed for 1.0.1.

The other in-game checks below were made on 1.0.0. Tested in game on Diablo II: Resurrected 3.3.0 build 93847 with D2RLoader 1.3.1: the panel opens and closes with the skill tree, its arrows and the mouse wheel switch specs in town and are refused outside it, specs with spent points come back exactly, a respec token stays on the active spec, and each spec gets its left and right mouse skills back.
limits: Calls native game code at fixed addresses, each with a byte check; if a check fails, swapping and the spec panel turn themselves off, which another plugin hooking one of those functions can also cause. Tested on D2R 3.3; on other game builds it may still crash, and any crash is logged to the plugin's log.
TCP/IP games, the vanilla game, other resolutions on the final layout, legacy graphics, large font mode and Steam were not checked. Only the host can swap in TCP/IP.
A respec token replaces the active spec's saved skills. If the game crashes unsaved right after a swap from an empty spec, the spec swapped to can be overwritten with empty.

Only the active weapon set's mouse skills are remembered, and a spec stays on Attack until skills are picked in it and it is swapped away from once. Skills from item charges come back only while the same item is there.
A mod whose class skills have a skpoints formula cannot swap specs: the swap is refused.
